title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 11: Mayumi Hirose
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．１１ ～廣瀬真弓～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 11: Hirose Mayumi is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Mayumi Hirose. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.
